summary.text: Bob Look is the Democratic candidate for the Wisconsin State Assembly, District 87, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Republican incumbent Brent Jacobson.

paragraphs.text: Bob Look advanced from the Democratic primary for Wisconsin State Assembly District 87 on August 11, 2026, receiving 5,259 votes.
He previously ran for the Wisconsin State Senate in District 29 in 2022, advancing from the Democratic primary on August 9, 2022, and losing the general election to Cory Tomczyk, 62.4% to 37.5%.
